remarks: Students of the UIMLT Department had an informative and educational visit to the Punjab Forensic Science Agency Labs. The visit provided valuable exposure to modern forensic techniques, laboratory procedures, and practical applications in diagnostic and investigative sciences. It was a great learning opportunity for students to observe professional laboratory practices and interact with experts in the field. Special thanks to the Punjab Forensic Science Agency team for their hospitality and insightful guidance.
